# News Releases


Soligenix Announces Recent Updates and Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


-


-

-

PRINCETON, N.J.


, Nov. 6, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[Soligenix, Inc.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4815585-1&h=1680866008&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.soligenix.com%2F&a=Soligenix%2C+Inc.) (Nasdaq: SNGX) (Soligenix or the Company), a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing products to treat rare diseases where there is an unmet medical need, announced today its recent updates and financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.


"We are continuing to pursue all strategic options to maximize stockholder value, including within our own rare disease portfolio. This includes advancement of SGX945 (dusquetide) for Behçet's disease, which showed encouraging signs of biological activity and was generally safe and well-tolerated in a small, open-label Phase 2a proof-of-concept study, as well as our ThermoVax® heat-stable vaccine platform," stated Christopher J. Schaber, PhD, President and Chief Executive Officer of Soligenix. "With approximately $9.0 million in cash and cash equivalents as of September 30, 2026, which we believe is sufficient to fund our current operating plan into the second quarter of 2028, we are evaluating a number of potential opportunities, including but not limited to partnership, licensing, merger and acquisition, government grants and contracts, while advancing our existing pipeline. Maintaining our Nasdaq listing is also an important strategic asset that supports these efforts by preserving access to the public capital markets, enhancing our attractiveness to potential strategic partners and acquirers, and providing additional flexibility as we evaluate these opportunities."


**Financial Results – Quarter Ended September 30, 2026**


Soligenix had no revenue for the quarters ended September 30, 2026 and 2025.


Soligenix's net loss was $1.1 million, or ($0.05) per share, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to $2.5 million, or ($0.58) per share, for the same prior year period. This decrease in net loss was primarily due to a decrease in research and development expenses associated with the terminated FLASH2 trial and related HyBryte™ development activities, and a gain on extinguishment of vendor liabilities.


Research and development expenses were $0.4 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, as compared to $1.6 million for the same period in 2025. The decrease was primarily due to decreases in costs associated with the terminated FLASH2 trial and related HyBryte™ development activities.


General and administrative expenses were $1.0 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 as compared to $1.0 million for the same period in 2025, relatively flat with a de minimis increase.


As of September 30, 2026, the Company had cash and cash equivalents of approximately $9.0 million.


**About Soligenix, Inc.**


Soligenix is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing products to treat rare diseases where there is an unmet medical need. Our Specialized BioTherapeutics business segment is developing synthetic hypericin for the treatment of psoriasis (SGX302), and our first-in-class Innate Defense Regulator (IDR) technology, dusquetide, for the treatment of inflammatory diseases, including aphthous ulcers in Behçet's Disease (BD) (SGX945) and oral mucositis in head and neck cancer (SGX942).


Our Public Health Solutions business segment includes development programs for RiVax®, our ricin toxin vaccine candidate, as well as our vaccine programs targeting filoviruses (such as Marburg and Ebola). The development of our vaccine programs incorporates the use of our proprietary heat stabilization platform technology, known as ThermoVax®. To date, this business segment has been supported with government grant and contract funding from the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID), the Defense Threat Reduction Agency (DTRA) and the Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority (BARDA).
